documents.title: Presentation - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026
Recording - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026
Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results, Limited Review Report for September 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Wheels India Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting standalone gross revenues of Rs 1,386.07 crs and consolidated gross revenues of Rs 1,492.79 crs. Management estimated the capex for FY27 to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs. The company outlined key strategic focus areas including growing exports, ramping up renewable energy component facilities, expanding the hydraulic cylinder business, and optimizing working capital to improve ROCE and RONW. Management reported a strong performance in Q4 FY26 with a 23% growth in sales and a 45% improvement in PAT, alongside crossing INR 5,000 crores in revenue for the full year. The growth was driven by favorable tailwinds including GST 2.0, stable commodity prices, and relative lowering of interest rates over the 12-month period.

guidance.claim: Capex for FY27 is estimated to be between Rs 400 and Rs 450 crores.
guidance.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

guidance.claim: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 280 to Rs 300 crs.
guidance.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 280 to Rs 300 crs

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects capex in the current year to be between INR 280 crores to INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And we expect in the current year, it will be between INR280 crores to INR300 crores of capex.

capex_expansion.claim: In aluminium wheels, the company is increasing capacity to 60,000 per month in a few months and then to 80,000 by half year.
capex_expansion.quote: We are increasing it -- in a few months we are increasing it to 60,000 and then by half year, we'll increase it to 80,000.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex of FY26 is mainly towards expanding capacity for machining of large castings, windmill products, automotive aluminium & steel wheels, Earth mover and Big agri wheels apart from certain routine capex and cost saving projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex of FY26 is mainly towards expanding capacity for machining of large castings, windmill products, automotive aluminium & steel wheels, Earth mover and Big agri wheels apart from certain routine capex and cost saving projects.

margins_costs.claim: The company had a forex profit of about INR 4 crores as a net thing in the current quarter and close to INR 10 crores for the whole year.
margins_costs.quote: So in the current quarter, we had a profit of about INR4 crores as a net thing on the forex. And for the whole year, it is about close to INR10 crores as forex gain.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization, with a thrust on profitability, is a key strategy going forward.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimization, with a thrust on profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined capacity for passenger car steel wheels between the company and its subsidiary is about 11 million to 12 million.
orders_capacity.quote: So if you take passenger car, steel wheels between us and our subsidiary, if I look at it combined, I think Wheels India has got a capacity of about 4 million and the subsidiary has got a capacity of about 7 million. So about 11 million to 12 million is the capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: In aluminum wheels, the company currently has a capacity of about 42,000 per month.
orders_capacity.quote: In aluminium wheels we currently have a capacity of about 42,000 per month.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt is maintained at Q1 FY27 levels.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt is maintained at Q1 FY27 levels.

capital_allocation.claim: The company aims to increase its stake in Axles India over a period of time.
capital_allocation.quote: So the idea was that Wheels India can get improve its stake, so we are looking at maybe something like 15%, maybe slightly higher, 20%, 25% over a period of time.

capital_allocation.claim: Free Cash Flow stands at 83Crs in FY26.
capital_allocation.quote: Free Cash Flow (FCF) stands at 83Crs in FY26

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that West Asia crisis and inflation in industrial fuel costs affected the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: The effect is basically -- one is fuel costs have gone up. Industrial fuel costs went up far ahead of what has happened for the citizens of the country.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to grow exports of wheels for construction equipment and agricultural tractors.
management_commitments.quote: Grow exports of wheels for construction equipment and agricultural tractors

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to grow the hydraulic cylinder business.
Management plans to ramp up the cast aluminium wheel business.
Management intends to grow the bus air suspension business.
Management focuses on funding capex predominantly through accruals and holding debt at current levels.
management_commitments.quote: Fund capex predominantly thro accruals and holding the debt at current levels

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the double-digit EBITDA part of the strategy is likely 1 or 2 years away.
management_commitments.quote: So I think as and when that happens, I think we're probably 2 years away -- 1 or 2 years away from double-digit EBITDA.

management_commitments.claim: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 280 to Rs 300 crs.
management_commitments.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 280 to Rs 300 crs

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to ramp-up the expanded facility for machining of large castings for windmills and step up capacity and volumes of fabricated, structural parts for windmills including off-shore WEGs.
management_commitments.quote: Ramp-up the expanded facility for machining of large castings for windmills; Also Step up the capacity and volumes of the fabricated, structural parts for windmills, including off-shore WEGs
